nodes.label: cors()
nodes.rationale: A route directive rather than a plain middleware, and options cover exact-match allowlist, wildcard, or a per-request predicate (a throwing predicate denies). Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoes the request origin; a literal * is sent only for withAnyOrigin() without credentials.

nodes.label: Preflight route synthesis
nodes.rationale: A preflight OPTIONS request never matches a method-specific route, so a plain middleware would never run for it. The compiler therefore expands cors() into both response decoration and a synthesised OPTIONS route per pattern. Because those synthesised routes are ordinary children of any enclosing withMiddleware, and preflights are anonymous by spec, cors() must sit outside auth or every preflight 401s.

nodes.label: Credentials and wildcard conflict
nodes.rationale: withAnyOrigin().withCredentials() throws at construction because the Fetch spec forbids Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with credentials. Vary: Origin is merged case-insensitively and additively whenever the origin is echoed, so caches never cross-serve and an existing Vary: Cookie survives.
